rooms.name: Sluice Arrival
rooms.note: Teach: single jump, running gap over water, double jump to the door.

rooms.name: Drain Well
rooms.note: Drain Well: shortcut ledges at the top, a one-way zigzag descent to the floor hole into A03.

rooms.name: Silt Walk
rooms.note: Silt Walk: dropped in beside a shut sluice gate; run the silt channels to the wheel at the far end.

rooms.name: Cistern Court
rooms.note: Cistern Court: cross the high line (decks, a moving barge, crumbles) over the basin; a zigzag climbs back.

rooms.name: Spillway Rise
rooms.note: Spillway Rise: a 70 u climb (room + shaft); timed spill sheets between the columns.

rooms.name: Pump Gallery
rooms.note: Pump Gallery: pistons over the flood going left, a climb, then the high line back right; a wheel opens the A02 shortcut.

rooms.name: Keeper Refuge
rooms.note: Keeper Refuge: rest. Steps down from both doors, flat floor.

rooms.name: Sluice Guardian Arena
rooms.note: Sluice Guardian Arena: flat floor, two fight ledges, a zigzag to the Heart door; floor hole to A10.

rooms.name: Settling Cache
rooms.note: Settling Cache (optional): a zigzag climb back up through the 16 u shaft to A04.

rooms.name: Keeper Archive
rooms.note: Keeper Archive (optional): the long climb back through the 30 u shaft, crumbles in the upper half.

rooms.name: Garden Arrival
rooms.note: Garden Arrival: teach the swing over a thorn bed (a running double jump also clears it), then up to the ceiling shaft.

rooms.name: Canopy Walk
rooms.note: Canopy Walk: two swings over thorns, then a Bloomfall pod bounce up to the door shelf.

rooms.name: Root Ladder
rooms.note: Root Ladder: drop down the ladder; a thorny right wall up high keeps climbs to the left wall; C10 and the C06 shortcut open off the right.

rooms.name: Seed Cradle
rooms.note: Seed Cradle: the exit gate is shut; climb the left side to the latch by the C09 door, then swing across to the exit.

rooms.name: Rootfall Well
rooms.note: Rootfall Well: crumbling roots down to the C06 door; moss walls for the way back.

rooms.name: Bloom Court
rooms.note: Bloom Court: a three-anchor swing chain over thorns to the C07 door; a latch opens the C03 shortcut.

rooms.name: Gardener Rest
rooms.note: Gardener Rest: steps down from the door; the floor shaft drops into the arena.

rooms.name: Root Guardian Arena
rooms.note: Root Guardian Arena: flat floor, fight ledges, a ledge ladder back up to the C07 shaft; floor hole to the Heart.

rooms.name: Hidden Nursery
rooms.note: Hidden Nursery (optional): a four-anchor swing over thorns with one island to rest on.

rooms.name: Hanging Garden
rooms.note: Hanging Garden (optional): crumbling roots and a pod over thorns to the high ledge.

rooms.name: Windward Shelter
rooms.note: Windward Shelter: rock below the door; climb on the right, then cross the gust lane in its calm.

rooms.name: Leeward Well
rooms.note: Leeward Well: descend through two gust bands to the floor shaft; the D04 shortcut joins low.

rooms.name: Vane Court
rooms.note: Vane Court: glide from the door down to the floor shaft; the optional D09 lies beyond three timed gusts.

rooms.name: Wind Bridge
rooms.note: Wind Bridge: 36 u over thorns: crumbles, a gust and an island; the D02 shortcut climbs from the island.

rooms.name: Updraft Hall
rooms.note: Updraft Hall: glide left across the hall to the D06 door; a lift and ledges rise to the D10 shaft.

rooms.name: Baffled Drop
rooms.note: Baffled Drop: glide down past alternating rock baffles to the low D07 door.

rooms.name: Still-Air Rest
rooms.note: Still-Air Rest.

rooms.name: Wind Guardian Arena
rooms.note: Wind Guardian Arena: flat floor, fight ledges, a ledge ladder to the D05 shortcut shaft; floor hole to the Heart.

rooms.name: Glider Roost
rooms.note: Glider Roost (optional): glide and dash over thorns with one crumbling perch.

rooms.name: Cloud Archive
rooms.note: Cloud Archive (optional): a lift, then a gust lane to the far ledge.

rooms.name: Quiet Arrival
rooms.note: Quiet Arrival: steps up to both doors.

rooms.name: Memory Well
rooms.note: Memory Well: down the well, a thread catch on the way; moss walls back up.

rooms.name: First Memory
rooms.note: First Memory: caught under the shaft, then glide (or pod-bounce) across the thorns to the E04 door.

rooms.name: Processional Walk
rooms.note: Processional Walk: a slow, flat walk.

rooms.name: The Wilted Sanctuary
rooms.note: The Wilted Sanctuary: right to left, one of each: glide, swing, gust in its calm, pod bounce, a long jump.

rooms.name: Return Stair
rooms.note: Return Stair: wall-jump climb between alternating ledges to the ceiling shaft.

rooms.name: Last Refuge
rooms.note: Last Refuge: rest, the reward on its pedestal, steps to all three doors.

rooms.name: Final Threshold
rooms.note: Final Threshold: three steps up to the Heart.

rooms.name: Lost Seed Archive
rooms.note: Lost Seed Archive (optional): crumbles over thorns up to the shaft.

rooms.name: Sanctuary Alcove
rooms.note: Sanctuary Alcove (optional): cross a gust over thorns to the reward pedestal.

rooms.name: The Great Heart Hall
rooms.note: Great Heart Hall: four sealed sector balconies around the heart; none reaches it (user, 31 Oct).

rooms.name: Warm Crack
rooms.note: Warm Crack: the reward on its step, a step up to the Moss Pocket door, a ladder to the ceiling shaft.

rooms.name: Moss Pocket
rooms.note: Moss Pocket: crumbling roots down over thorns; the heart seed sits high on the right, up the moss wall.

rooms.name: Pale Alcove
rooms.note: Pale Alcove: the lore stone below, ledges up to the ceiling shaft.

rooms.name: Root Gallery
rooms.note: Root Gallery: a rock slab over the floor shaft sends the climb round the left side.

rooms.name: High Crevice
rooms.note: High Crevice: the amber at the foot, thorns on the left floor; climb the right wall back up.

rooms.name: Hanging Garden
rooms.note: Hanging Garden (way in): hanging ledges over thorns, the reward floor, a moss climb to the High Crevice door.

rooms.name: Underarch Workshop
rooms.note: Underarch Workshop: ledges from the Silt Cistern door up to the ceiling shaft.

rooms.name: Silt Cistern
rooms.note: Silt Cistern: swing the anchor line over the water; the heart seed on its island, a ledge ladder back up.

rooms.name: Echo Vault
rooms.note: Echo Vault: anchors from the door shelf up to the ceiling shaft; the reward below on its pedestal.

rooms.name: Ring Gallery
rooms.note: Ring Gallery: a lift on the left, then ledges round a rock slab to the ceiling shaft.

rooms.name: Moss Tower
rooms.note: Moss Tower: the amber at the foot, a thorny low left wall; climb the right wall.

rooms.name: High Arch
rooms.note: High Arch (way in): an eight-anchor arch over thorns, the reward floor, the floor shaft to the Workshop.

rooms.name: Sluice Cellar
rooms.note: Sluice Cellar: water floor, the heart seed on the dry floor; a pod up to the door shelf, crumbling grain to the ceiling shaft.

rooms.name: Grain Store
rooms.note: Grain Store: crumbling grain steps down from the left door to the right one over thorns; the amber on the dry floor.

rooms.name: Farmer Shelter
rooms.note: Farmer Shelter: a few ledges up to the ceiling shaft.

rooms.name: Mill Undercroft
rooms.note: Mill Undercroft: a rock slab over the floor shaft; a piston lift and ledges up to the ceiling shaft.

rooms.name: Wind Shelf
rooms.note: Wind Shelf: a ledge walk through timed wind shears between the doors; the reward below the right shelf.

rooms.name: Root Hanger
rooms.note: Root Hanger (way in): a swing line to the floor shaft, pods to the reward, a ledge to the Wind Shelf door.

rooms.name: Lost Lantern
rooms.note: Lost Lantern: crumbling stones over thorns to the find.

rooms.name: Root Loom
rooms.note: Root Loom: a four-anchor swing over thorns to the heart seed and back.

rooms.name: Moss Well
rooms.note: Moss Well: a non-cling rock wall splits the well; climb the moss walls up and over to the reward.

rooms.name: Seed Choir
rooms.note: Seed Choir: three pods over thorns, struck one after another, to the reward.

rooms.name: Stone Drum
rooms.note: Stone Drum: a non-cling wall too high for the double jump; bounce off the drum pod to clear it.

rooms.name: Canopy Pocket
rooms.note: Canopy Pocket: up the left wall, glide over the thorns to the reward; swing back along the canopy.

rooms.name: Sheltered Nest
rooms.note: Sheltered Nest: three timed gust lanes along the floor; dash through each calm to the heart seed.

rooms.name: Clasp Hollow
rooms.note: Clasp Hollow: swing over thorns to the reward; a ledge on the right for the swing back.

rooms.name: Wind Window
rooms.note: Wind Window: two full-height gust walls; dash through in their calm.

rooms.name: Echo Steps
rooms.note: Echo Steps: crumbling steps over thorns to the reward.

rooms.name: High Drift
rooms.note: High Drift: up the left wall and glide down to the reward; climb the right wall and swing back.

rooms.name: Weather Cave
rooms.note: Weather Cave: crumbling steps through two gust walls over thorns.

rooms.name: Reed Shelter
rooms.note: Reed Shelter: crumbling reeds over thorns to the lore stone.

rooms.name: Falls Pocket
rooms.note: Falls Pocket: swing over the pool through two falling sheets to the heart seed.

rooms.name: Pale Archive
rooms.note: Pale Archive: ride the shelf across the thorns to the reward.

rooms.name: Quiet Terrace
rooms.note: Quiet Terrace: glide over thorns to the reward; up the right wall and swing back.

rooms.name: Watcher's Hollow
rooms.note: Watcher's Hollow: up the left wall, glide over thorns to the find; the right wall and a glide back.

rooms.name: Upper Cleft
rooms.note: Upper Cleft (entered on the right): up the moss wall and over a non-cling rock to the amber; a ladder back.

rooms.name: Firefly Nook
rooms.note: Firefly Nook: a rock rise too high for one jump; the first place to use the Leapseed.

rooms.name: Old Footprints
rooms.note: Old Footprints: a double-jump shelf.

rooms.name: Fern Pocket
rooms.note: Fern Pocket: a rock rise too high for one jump.

rooms.name: Mason’s Recess
rooms.note: Mason's Recess: a find on the floor.

rooms.name: Dripstone Hollow
rooms.note: Dripstone Hollow: up the right wall to the shelf.

rooms.name: Forgotten Satchel
rooms.note: Forgotten Satchel: a crumbling step over thorns.

rooms.name: Seed Shelf
rooms.note: Seed Shelf: swing over the thorns to the find.

rooms.name: Millstone Pocket
rooms.note: Millstone Pocket: climb the moss wall to a perch and drop over the millstone to the heart seed.

rooms.name: Lantern Rest
rooms.note: Lantern Rest: through a timed drip.

rooms.name: Rootlight Niche
rooms.note: Rootlight Niche: bounce off the pod to clear the root wall.

rooms.name: Quiet Wind Pocket
rooms.note: Quiet Wind Pocket: through a gust in its calm.

rooms.name: Last Cairn
rooms.note: Last Cairn: a gust over thorns guards the lore stone; dash through the calm.

limits: Room checks ignore ceilings and walls between surfaces, enemies, gust push and moving-platform timing; the surface check reads the route data, not scene colliders.
A "blocked" result means no move in the best-case model gets there; a real-engine check in Unity stage still has to confirm it.
Scripted checks prove logic, never feel.
